data.one_liner: Enables Flutter apps to communicate with apps running on WearOS devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper to communicate with WearOS applications via the Data Layer API. Allows sending messages, syncing data items, transferring files, managing device capabilities, and tracking connected devices.
use_when: Building a companion WearOS app for your Flutter Android application.
Synchronizing data, messages, or capabilities between a phone and a smartwatch.
avoid_when: Targeting non-Android smartwatches or Apple Watch (use alternative watch packages instead).
Building general mobile-to-mobile connectivity apps without wearables.
strengths: Supports device discovery, message passing, and capability querying.
Provides stream-based listening for data changes and messages.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to Android and WearOS ecosystem.
Requires proper companion app package name alignment.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a WearOS companion app with the same package name as the Android app and calling configureWearableAPI() before use.
